name: com.bionics.implicitsave
description: Zero-config save system for Unity. Declaring a class is enough - no central ScriptableObject, no manual registration, no references to maintain.

samples.description: The demo scene. One save class, changed from buttons, written by autosave and read back on the next Play.
Save slots: create, switch, copy, rename and delete profiles, with the same save class stored once per slot.
A list declared as a base type holding mixed subtypes, with [SerializeReference] and [SaveType], and the file that results.
Loading files written by older versions of a save class through two ISaveMigration steps, and what happens with a file from a newer build.
